decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on the 6 November 2001 the side extension (of dimensions 2.8m in height,1.1m in width and 2.9m in depth to the extent of the rear of the existing building and the rear extension of 3.4m in height, 4m in depth and 3.4m in depth) would have been lawful within the meaning of Sections 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended)  for the following reasons:

 The volume of the proposed side and rear extension is less than 50m3 and falls within Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of  single storey rear extension and erection of roof extension incorporating 2 roof lights to front and rear elevations of existing dwellinghouse.
